UpdateStageDescription: Downloads the latest AssaultCube release from GitHub
Downloads the latest AssaultCube release from GitHub
Runs the installer silently into a temporary folder, then copies it into the server folder without replacing existing config files
UpdateSourceArgs: /C set __COMPAT_LAYER=RunAsInvoker& rd /S /Q "{{$FullRootDir}}ac-install" > NUL 2>&1 & for %f in ("{{$FullRootDir}}ac-download\AssaultCube_v*.exe") do (start "" /wait "%f" /S /D={{$FullRootDir}}ac-install) & if not exist "{{$FullRootDir}}ac-install\bin_win32\ac_server.exe" (echo AssaultCube installer did not produce the server executable & exit /b 1) else (robocopy "{{$FullRootDir}}ac-install\config" "{{$FullBaseDir}}config" /E /XC /XN /XO /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP > NUL & robocopy "{{$FullRootDir}}ac-install" "{{$FullBaseDir}}." /E /XD "{{$FullRootDir}}ac-install\config" /XF Uninstall.exe /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP > NUL & rd /S /Q "{{$FullRootDir}}ac-install" "{{$FullRootDir}}ac-download" > NUL 2>&1 & if not exist "{{$FullBaseDir}}bin_win32\ac_server.exe" (exit /b 1) else (echo AssaultCube installed/updated & exit /b 0))

UpdateStageDescription: Extracts the release into a temporary folder, then copies it into the server folder without replacing existing config files
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" && rm -rf ac-install && mkdir -p ac-install \"{{$FullBaseDir}}config\" && tar -xjf ac-download/AssaultCube_v*.tar.bz2 -C ac-install && cp -rn ac-install/config/. \"{{$FullBaseDir}}config/\" && rm -rf ac-install/config && cp -rf ac-install/. \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" && chmod +x \"{{$FullBaseDir}}bin_unix/linux_64_server\" && rm -rf ac-install ac-download && echo 'AssaultCube installed/updated'"
